name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: Backend Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Microservices | REST API Design & Optimization | CI/CD & Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Backend Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling distributed backend systems in finance and retail. Specializes in .NET microservices, RESTful API optimization, and CI/CD automation — consistently reducing response times, improving deployment velocity, and increasing system reliability in remote, cross-functional teams.

bullets: Designed and built 10+ scalable microservices using .NET Framework/Core for inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily in a high-throughput backend environment.
Optimized RESTful APIs through improved error handling, caching, and versioning, reducing average response time by 25–35% and improving system performance at scale.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases with >95% success rate.
Enforced code quality standards via SonarQube and unit testing, reducing production defects by 30% and improving long-term maintainability of backend services.
Collaborated with product and planning teams to deliver backend solutions that improved forecast accuracy and reduced stock discrepancies across global retail operations.
Contributed to high-volume backend infrastructure supporting a global retail client's scalable inventory processing and decision-making systems.
Developed microservices in .NET and Java for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations with demanding throughput and reliability requirements.
Implemented asynchronous processing pipelines and service integrations via JBoss Fuse, increasing system throughput by 30% and reducing transaction latency.
Designed fault-tolerant backend services, reducing service downtime and improving system resilience through distributed systems patterns.
Centralized business rules using JBoss BRMS, accelerating credit approval processes by 20–25% and eliminating operational bottlenecks through automated decision logic.
Delivered production backend services powering digital credit and mobile wallet platforms at scale.
Developed backend APIs and web applications using .NET Core and SQL Server, improving data accessibility and backend performance for business operations.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing complex reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Enabled faster data-driven decision-making by building dashboards that reduced reporting turnaround from days to hours.
Maintained and enhanced internal HR and finance systems, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Developed reporting tools that automated manual workflows, saving dozens of administrative hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
